stories.title: Sular çekilince dev operasyon başladı: 17 milyar tohumu toprağa saçmaya başladılar

en.title: Major operation begins as waters recede: they started scattering 17 billion seeds into the soil
en.summary: Following the removal of four large dams on the Klamath River between Oregon and California, a significant ecological restoration project has commenced involving the dispersal of billions of seeds in the region.

stories.title: Artvin’de 1 günde 2 ATV kazası: 2 kişi hayatını kaybetti

en.title: 2 ATV accidents in Artvin in one day: 2 people died
en.summary: Two separate ATV accidents occurred in Artvin's Şavşat district on the same day, resulting in two fatalities. An investigation into the incidents has been launched.

stories.title: Metro İstanbul bugün yeni tarifeye geçiyor

en.title: Metro Istanbul switches to new tariff today
en.summary: Metro Istanbul announced it will transition to winter schedule on all lines on Monday, September 14, with 512 additional daily trips planned.

stories.title: Gişelere çarpan yolcu otobüsü alev alev yandı, yolculuk kabusa döndü: 2 ölü, 8 yaralı

en.title: Passenger bus hitting toll booths caught fire, journey turned into nightmare: 2 dead, 8 injured
en.summary: A passenger bus traveling on Istanbul's Northern Marmara Highway struck toll booths and caught fire in the Eyüpsultan district, resulting in two deaths and eight injuries.

stories.title: İstanbul’un iki ilçesinde ceset bulundu: Biri boş arazide, diğeri surların içinde

en.title: Two male bodies found in two Istanbul districts: One in empty land, the other within walls
en.summary: Male corpses were discovered in separate locations in Istanbul's Başakşehir and Fatih districts. Police are investigating both cases.

stories.title: Fatih’te surlar, Başakşehir’de boş arazi: İstanbul’da iki ilçede ceset bulundu!

en.title: Walls in Fatih, empty land in Başakşehir: Two male bodies found in two Istanbul districts
en.summary: Two male bodies were found in Istanbul's Başakşehir and Fatih districts, identified as 24-year-old Eray Deniz Sarı and 40-year-old İsa Çam. Autopsies will determine the exact causes of death.

stories.title: Uyuşturucu soruşturmasında bir ünlü isim daha gözaltına alındı

en.title: Another prominent figure detained in drug investigation
en.summary: Three suspects, including actress Çağla Boz, were detained as part of a drug investigation.

stories.title: Suriye Cumhurbaşkanı Şara, Bakan Fidan'ı kabul etti

en.title: Syrian President Shara receives Minister Fidan
en.summary: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan met with Syrian President Ahmed Shara in Damascus as part of official diplomatic contacts.

stories.title: İstanbul'da otobüs alev alev yandı: 2 ölü, 8 yaralı

en.title: Bus catches fire in Istanbul: 2 dead, 8 injured
en.summary: A bus lost control on a wet road in Istanbul and struck a barrier, causing a fire that killed 2 people and injured 8 others.

stories.title: Kuzey Marmara Otoyolu’nda şehirler arası yolcu otobüsü gişelere çarptı!

en.title: Intercity bus hits toll booth on North Marmara Highway
en.summary: An intercity bus collided with a toll booth on Istanbul's North Marmara Highway, resulting in a fire on the vehicle.

stories.title: İstanbul'da ünlülere yönelik uyuşturucu operasyonu: Oyuncu Çağla Boz gözaltına alındı

en.title: Drug operation targeting celebrities in Istanbul: Actress Çağla Boz detained
en.summary: Istanbul authorities conducted a drug investigation operation resulting in detention orders for five suspects, including lawyer Emek Emre and actress Çağla Boz.

stories.title: Bakan Fidan Şam'da duyurdu: Başkan Erdoğan Suriye'yi ziyaret edecek

en.title: Minister Fidan announces in Damascus: President Erdoğan will visit Syria
en.summary: Turkey's Foreign Minister announced that President Erdoğan will visit Syria, noting that Turkish-Syrian relations have gained momentum over two years.

stories.title: Hakem Kurulu açıkladı: Manchester derbisinde hata yapıldı

en.title: Referee Board announces: Mistake made in Manchester derby
en.summary: England's Referee Board acknowledged that a refereeing error occurred during a Manchester derby match in the Premier League.

en.title: Measures against anti-dumping initiative
en.summary: Turkish cement producers are responding to anti-dumping efforts from U.S. competitors seeking higher prices. Industry leaders have begun legal proceedings in Washington to address the challenge to Turkish exports, which supply 7-8 million tons annually to the American market.

en.title: They will knit socks for the world
en.summary: Selfiko, a knitting kit company founded by five cousins, is expanding globally with educational materials for beginners. The brand, currently sold in five countries from Italy to the United States, plans to enter new European markets.

stories.title: Hazır giyimde daralma içerde talebi düşürdü

en.title: Contraction in ready-made clothing reduced domestic demand
en.summary: A 15.1% decline in ready-made garment production has reduced domestic demand for textile inputs like yarn and fabric. The textile sector experienced a 1.5% contraction during the same period.

stories.title: VakıfBank Genel Müdürü Arslan: Nitelikli yapı stokuna katkı sağlamaya devam ediyoruz

en.title: VakıfBank General Manager Arslan: We continue to contribute to qualified building stock
en.summary: The VSancaktepe Merkez project by Vakıf Real Estate Investment Trust has been completed, with residents beginning to move into their new homes. VakıfBank's general manager reaffirmed the organization's commitment to supporting the country's economy and quality construction inventory.
